content.short: Superbridge lets rollups quickly spin up a themed, customizable bridge frontend.
content.description: Superbridge provides a user-friendly, native bridge frontend for rollups, letting you spin up a themed and customizable bridge UI in minutes. With Superbridge you can bridge Ether and other tokens into and out of any supported rollup. Superbridge Rollies deliver a dedicated UI for OP Stack or Arbitrum Orbit rollups. It also serves as the user interface for the Native Bridge contracts on the Superchain. Optimism and Base direct their users to Superbridge for native bridging.
content.meta: Superbridge is a user-friendly, native bridge for rollups. Discover Superbridge and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
